details: Leading a research team focused on advancing frontier AI research based on real-world long-horizon trajectory data.

Spearheading research on Recursive Self-improvement (RSI) and Long-horizon World Interaction, enabling AI agents to accumulate and use long-term knowledge while autonomously controlling embodied robots.
Driving research initiatives from problem formulation to prototype development, while collaborating with engineering teams for practical deployment.
Contributing to the growth of the lab, which recently secured nearly ten million RMB in funding to advance AI research.
highlights: Lead research on recursive self-improvement and long-horizon interaction, enabling agents to learn and control embodied robots.
Guide research from problem formulation to prototypes, working with engineering teams on real-world embodied AI applications.

details: Researching scalable post-training techniques for multimodal foundation models, injecting e-commerce domain knowledge to improve product retrieval and find-similar-item applications.
Designed and implemented training and evaluation pipelines to improve product representation learning, visual-semantic alignment, and retrieval performance in large-scale e-commerce scenarios.
highlights: Research: combined multimodal representations with OPD, exploring post-training, SFT, and industrial product benchmarks.
Business: studied image-text alignment data pipelines for product representations and retrieval in large-scale e-commerce.

details: Worked on AI infrastructure for LLM training and inference on Huawei Ascend 910B, including precision alignment.
highlights: Focused on AI infrastructure for LLM training and inference on Huawei Ascend 910B, emphasizing efficient and stable execution.

details: Focusing on efficient machine learning and multimodal model evaluation.
